{{Top|leg}}
'''Armored Clothing''' was a category of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] covering vests, [[Jacket/Legends|jackets]], and pants that were plated with [[plastoid]] or ceramic pads, sometimes with [[Mesh armor|mesh]] energy-dispersion layers. Very light in nature, the armor covered vital organs; with the plates woven into the fabric being very difficult to spot.

An example of this armor was the [["ShadowStalker" assassin gear]] produced by [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]].
